output.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] and [ev-5a31c0781dc5] describe the removal of a whole Helm chart: `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote` is replaced by installing the istiod chart with `--set profile=remote`. `istiod-remote` is a chart name, not a key in a values file, so values-key{path: "istiod-remote", state: set} never reads the real exposure. That exposure is having a release installed from the istiod-remote chart. None of the available predicates can express "installed from chart X", and this is not runtime behaviour, so an undecidable leaf does not fit either. Applicability should be marked undetermined rather than asserted with this condition.
